notes.title: 🦊 Harmony in the Wild: New Demo! 🌿
notes.content:
Hey Adventurer! ✨

We're excited to share with you that our game Harmony in the Wild has a NEW demo! 🧡

🎮 You can try it out for the first time, or if you're a returning player discover all these new features:

[list]
[*] New Weather system - it might get chilly!
[*] New day/night cycles - the sunset is best enjoyed in the flower field.
[*] Updated UI - easier to navigate.
[*] Improved graphics - explore the vibrant forest!
[*] New music - it's even more soothing.
[*] More collectibles - crystals and runes bring the magic to your adventure!
[/list]
Let's restore nature's balance and bring it back to life!

We would love to hear your thoughts! Join our community [url=https://discord.gg/yuTHUTqSuA]Discord[/url] server to share your feedback. Your input will help us improve Harmony in the Wild!

Thank you for your support! 🥰

🦊 P.S. Wishlist Harmony in the Wild to get updates & be the first to know about our upcoming release! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360850/Harmony_in_the_Wild
